placements.name: Introduction to Data Analytics
placements.reason: Four 6cp slots draw on the same seven options, of which CBK91234 Technical subject choice is the broadest. All four picks come from it, so the plan reads as one coherent technical thread rather than four unrelated sub-majors. 31250 Introduction to Data Analytics runs in both sessions and has its prerequisites met by Year 1. An earlier draft chose 31061 Database Principles, which the solver rejected: 31271 Database Fundamentals is a core subject of this sequence and the two are genuine mutual anti-requisites, so both could never count. 48730 Cybersecurity was the next candidate and was rejected in turn, because it requires one of six subjects none of which this sequence schedules.

placements.name: Network Fundamentals
placements.reason: 41092 Network Fundamentals runs in both sessions and has no unmet requisite here. An earlier draft chose 48033 Internet of Things, which the checker rejected because it requires a networking subject (41092 among them) that the plan did not schedule. Taking 41092 itself both fixes the slot and would unlock 48033 as a later elective.

placements.name: Data Systems
placements.reason: 41091 Data Systems is Autumn only and follows 31061 Database Principles from Year 2 Autumn.

placements.name: System Security
placements.reason: 41182 System Security is Autumn only and sits late in the plan. An earlier draft chose 41900 Cryptography, which the checker rejected because it requires 48730 Cybersecurity or 65325, neither scheduled. With 31061, 41092 and 41091 already placed, the four picks now read as one thread across data, networks and security rather than four unrelated subjects.
